details: Malicious package. `superlib_ex3` is a multi-stage loader: on install it fetches and executes a second-stage payload from the attacker-controlled host `x.exxcube.fr` (the install hook was observed in dynamic detonation retrieving `https://x.exxcube.fr/postInstall`). No legitimate functionality; all published versions are malicious. Full indicators at the reference below.
